workingHub.title: Internal tools wiki and training hub
workingHub.summary: Central searchable place for training, documentation, and tool discovery across Revit tools, Windows apps, and web-based apps.
focusPoints: Tool catalogue: list each tool and what problem it solves.
Training mode: simulate behavior with dummy data before live usage.
Project safety: identify whether a tool edits views, sheets, parameters, files, or model data.
Shared learning: capture known fixes, helper patterns, and examples for new tools.
Broader scope: include pyRevit tools, package utilities, verification tools, and desktop apps.

sections.content: Purpose, owner, status, Revit version, dependencies, data modified, risk level.
Workflow, screenshots, expected inputs, expected outputs, rollback guidance.
Dummy data, example parameters, sample folders, safe test scenarios.
Folder path, file structure, known limitations, error messages, planned improvements.
Internal setup guide, pyRevit docs, Revit API docs, VS Code setup notes, idea portal.
